description: Load more SCF tool groups into this session (teams, collaboration, documents, engagements, assurance, catalog-reconciliation, webhooks, journey, or all). Returns the tools now available.

groups.description:
teams — Business functions, teams, rosters and team accountability for controls and evidence (scf_team_read, scf_team_write)
collaboration — User assignments and comment threads on controls, evidence and tasks (scf_collaboration_read, scf_collaboration_write)
documents — ISMS document generation, sections, lifecycle transitions and export (scf_document_read, scf_document_write)
engagements — Audit engagements: scope, auditors, queries and responses (scf_engagement_read, scf_engagement_write)
assurance — Deficiencies, organization compensating controls, control validations, posture snapshots, capability tests (scf_assurance_read, scf_assurance_write)
catalog-reconciliation — Per-organization SCF catalog upgrade reconciliation runs (scf_catalog_reconciliation_read, scf_catalog_reconciliation_write)
webhooks — Webhook endpoints, secrets and delivery logs (scf_webhook_read, scf_webhook_write)
journey — The guided implementation journey: stages, templates, attestation (scf_journey_read, scf_journey_write)
all — every group above
Already loaded at startup: catalog, controls, evidence, assessments, risk, vendors, systems, organization.

name: scf_load_tools
